algorithm_scope: V18 mathematics; admission/decode/ordered single-owner engineering only

capture.start: Before the first physics/sensor message and stationary IMU initialization

matching.initial_state: Fresh equivalent estimator/map initialization, same frozen calibration/parameters and complete initialization prefix
matching.exact_cross_topic_order: Require production direct-feed harness with a fixed admission schedule and explicit timer schedule; otherwise report actual order SHA and UNVERIFIED exact-order causality
matching.bag_order: Bag recorder read order is separately hashed; do not label it the original executor callback order
matching.full_frontend_replay: Requires actual images and all inputs from initialization plus original calibration; kernel Hessian/state summaries alone are insufficient
matching.failed_or_dropped_input: Never replace, coalesce, relabel, skip, or refresh source timestamps to obtain PASS

benchmark.order: Alternating ABBA and BAAB blocks; every mode gets 32 independent processes per scene
benchmark.numeric_gate: Complete state/covariance/residual/accepted measurement ordering and required output non-wall payload byte equality; any narrower fixture must disclose its scope
benchmark.performance_gate: Report median/p95/p99/max and all trials. Do not infer whole-chain speedup from one kernel; require independent evidence before claiming a 10% median improvement without p95 regression

headroom.multiplier_changes: Wall release schedule only; original ROS acquisition headers and message body unchanged
headroom.stable: No growing backlog or source lag, no loss/cancel/rejection, and complete input delivery; source-age interpretation must use the same explicit simulated clock replay
headroom.timer_schedule: Freeze and replay the same timer events for exact finite comparison. Native wall timers during accelerated ROSbag playback invalidate an exact same-event claim

pipeline_gate.whole_lifecycle: accepted == delivered == committed == trace_rows; rejected == canceled == missing == 0; no failure
pipeline_gate.normal_stop: Quiesce ingress before ROS context invalidation; finish inflight decode; original owner drains by global admission sequence; close only with zero pending
pipeline_gate.emergency_stop: Record failures/canceled identities and fail the strict lifecycle gate; no cleanup exemption

actual_validation: New 60 s strict lifecycle and original prefix source/motion/guard gates
Full original 32-region route, 5 s parking, and both 12 m ramps
Subsequent 46-goal task requires its own source scope and unchanged protective gates

unchanged_protection.navigation_input: actual SLAM/IMU/cloud; simulator truth only offline evaluation

known_limit: Protocol and finite reader tests are not actual V19 performance, numeric, lifecycle, navigation or Sim2Sim PASS
